# Spatial Coordinates

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SpatialCoordinates`](gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SpatialCoordinates>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A set of coordinate values representing a position in a specific coordinate reference frame.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SpatialCoordinates`](gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a position expressed as coordinate values in a specific reference frame — the general frame-relative coordinate carrier.

### Avoid when

- Avoid stating coordinates without [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](../properties/gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) (the frame gate warns) and avoid it for the simple lat/long point case ([`GeoCoordinates`](gmeow-GeoCoordinates.md)).

### How to use

- Mint [`SpatialCoordinates`](gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md), declare [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](../properties/gmeow-coordinateFrame.md), and carry n-D values via [`gmeow:hasCoordinateMatrix`](../properties/gmeow-hasCoordinateMatrix.md) when beyond a simple triple.

### Examples

- ex:pos a [`gmeow:SpatialCoordinates`](gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md); [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](../properties/gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) [`gmeow:referenceFrameWGS84`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameWGS84.md).
